Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 29-Nov-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  SUBJECT: ECE 2124/ECE_2124 DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN  
  (SPL: ELECTRONICS AND COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING)  
  DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN [ECE 2124]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                        Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Design a 4-bit Excess-3 to BCD code converter and implement the minimized Boolean expression             (4)  
  using NAND gates only.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
$$1B)               Implement the logic functions F_{1}(A, B, C) = Σm(1, 4, 6), F_{2} (A, B, C) = Σm(3, 5), and F_{3} (A, B, C) = (3)$$  
  Σm(0, 2, 7) using a 1-to-8 demultiplexer and necessary additional logic gates. Assume that DEMUX  
  has active low outputs.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1C)               Design a 4:16 line decoder with active-high enable and active-high outputs by using 2:4 line             (3)  
  decoders and the necessary logic gates.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Create"  
  
2A)               Design a synchronous counter that follows the counting sequence 0, 1, 3, 4, 2, and then repeats.         (4)  
  Ensure that all unused states return to 0. Use positive edge-triggered T flip-flops for the design.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2B)               Design an asynchronous decade counter using positive edge triggered JK flipflops.                        (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2C)               Design a single-digit BCD adder using two 4-bit binary adders and realize the BCD correction             (3)  
  circuit using NAND gates. Explain the operation of the circuit with suitable examples.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3A)               Design a sequential circuit using Mealy machine that can detect the non-overlapping sequence             (4)  
  0110. Use positive edge triggered D flipflops.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Create"  
  
3B)               Apply the concept of characteristic table to convert a JK flip-flop into an equivalent D flip-flop.      (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  Page #1

3C)           Write a structural Verilog module for a full subtractor by hierarchically integrating half subtractors    (3)  
  and the necessary logic gates.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4A)           Write a behavioural Verilog coding for 8:3 priority encoder using nested if statement.                    (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4B)           For the given circuit in figure 4B, write a Verilog dataflow modelling by considering a delay of 10ns     (3)  
  for the execution of function, also draw the timing diagram for inputs and outputs.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4C)           Write a Verilog user defined primitive (UDP) for carryout output of full adder circuit.                   (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5A)           a) Implement SR latch using ACTEL ACT-1 module.                                                           (4)  
  b) Explain the architecture of ACT-2 C logic module.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5B)           Explain ASIC design flow with neat flow diagram.                                                          (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5C)           Explain with example                                                                                      (3)  
  i. Noise margin  
  ii. fan-in in digital circuit  
  iii. propagation delay  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  -----End-----
